title: Joe Virgis's claimed tunes: Jealous, Jelly Bean, Camel Walk
summary: Allen says Virgis claimed many tunes; Leclerc confirms Jelly Bean and Camel Walk and who published which of his numbers.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I hope we don't get sued, but you know, Joe Virgis told me he wrote Jealous.
Jealous? Yes, I don't remember Jealous. Yeah. He wrote Jelly Bean.
Yeah, but he claimed all these tunes, you know. I don't know how many of them he wrote.
He wrote Camel Walk, didn't he?

Yeah, yeah. He wrote Camel Walk. See, I hadn't even remembered that. Camel Walk, yeah. Well, of course, those numbers were published by the Triangle, you see. Now, you see, someday more movies were published by that. Triangle Blues, I think. I think Plessy did that too for me. Yeah. And Cookie. I don't know who published Cookie. Here it is right here.
